plugins.name: golang-architecture
plugins.description: Forces Go-idiomatic package boundaries and dependency direction for backend modules: domain/business-logic packages never import a concrete infrastructure package directly, ports are interfaces declared by the consumer package, and every concrete adapter is constructed in one composition root.

plugins.name: frontend-ui-architecture
plugins.description: Defines where frontend code lives and how it's layered: folder/feature structure, component-folder anatomy, component splitting, constants placement, utils vs helpers vs services, business-logic placement, types organization, and barrel-file conventions for plain React and Next.js App Router apps.
